scope.statement: Every verifier reachable from packet-2026-022 Stage A, the full B6.6 runner, cleanup, receipt validation and their plan guards was reviewed for equality, cardinality, ordering, tag, version and history assertions.
scope.binding: The revised packet source-hash table binds this audit and every listed executable source.

retained: Exact account, role, resource, path, action and digest identities
Exact security boundaries and zero-state requirements
Exact adopted speech-contract outcomes and stage ordering
Exact authorization, source-hash and receipt-chain bindings
prohibited: Whole-object equality when only named fields affect safety or function
List ordering when membership is the invariant
Historical version, tag or receipt counts
Extra deny-only policy statements that cannot expand access

corrections.after: Require initProcessEnabled=true, no added capabilities, and ALL among dropped capabilities; ignore unrelated normalized fields and harmless additional drops.

corrections.before: Fresh version stages equaled the one-item AWSCURRENT list
corrections.after: Require AWSCURRENT membership for the freshly created version without asserting on unrelated labels or historical cardinality.
Compare only minSize, maxSize and desiredSize cost/safety fields.
Semantic jq comparisons of plan counts and exact resource-name membership.

corrections.before: Security-group list ordering and exactly one total policy statement
corrections.after: Order-independent exact SG membership; exactly one bounded Allow statement while additional Deny-only statements are tolerated.
Require only the enumerated packet, stability, cleanup, zero-EKS, time, cost and unlock fields while receipt schema and dependency hashes remain exact.

retained_assertion_groups.rationale: Exact IDs, hashes, statuses, paths and dependency hashes are governance and tamper boundaries, not incidental runtime shape.
Exact changed-address and action sets prevent unauthorized mutation; zero counts prove cost and cleanup boundaries.
Exact scan-passed child digests, bounded replicas and Ready state prove supply-chain identity, cost ceiling and launch readiness.
Exact VPC, subnets, security groups, ports, routes, target health and required tag values implement isolation and functional routing. Extra unrelated tags are not rejected.
HTTP outcomes, model-version keys, event types, cancellation limit and controlled failure codes are adopted contract behavior.
Secret identity, KMS key, fresh canonical value, token length/mode/hash and operator denial are security/function invariants. Historical version and tag counts remain unevaluated.
